question: Does an identified historical coffer/chamber plan agree with independently measured corresponding coffer/chamber features in a declared local 2-D frame?
preregisteredAcceptance: Use the existing shared-engine historical-plan similarity profile unchanged, with its control/holdout and sector minima, independent scale check and untouched holdouts. Numerical success alone does not authenticate source identity or promote 3-D surfaces.
scope: PLAN_2D_ONLY; physical lid pose and assembly-to-monument/site transforms stay unresolved

sourceLeadsChecked.identity: Digital Giza catalog for Petrie, The Pyramids and Temples of Gizeh
sourceLeadsChecked.limitation: Catalog citation identifies a 1990 reprint of the 1883 work; exact edition/page/render identity and permitted use must be established from acquired bytes.
Text/citation access is not independently controlled feature coordinates or a source-render custody record.

existingRelevantLocators: Petrie sections 75–77, pp.105–108, as recorded in the existing component observations
missingInputs: Checksum-preserved, permitted-use source bytes for the correctly identified coffer/chamber image and its confirmed page/render
Feature-identifiable 2-D correspondences, not fabricated rectangle corners inferred from this model
Independent control source bytes and lineage demonstrating independence from both the underlying plan measurements and the model under evaluation
Independent scale provenance in metres per source-render pixel
Frozen controls and untouched holdouts distributed across the required sectors

reasonNoFit: Pre-fit evidence gates are unmet. No controls were invented and no unrelated valley-temple registration was borrowed.
